Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the dedicated capacity options. We want to move forward with ACE registration (AWS co-sell) but need a short list of artifacts and the right introduction to PDM/PSM so we can align our internal stakeholders and procurement.

- Can you loop in the PDM/PSM counterpart for a quick 45-minute intro to align on timeline and next steps? We need to sync with our Cloud Platform and Procurement teams.

Thanks,
